name: packsense-policy
purpose: Checks every night that the access rules are still as written: who can see and change what.

name: packsense-bronze-load
purpose: The daily update: fetches Open Food Facts' newest daily file, then loads it and cleans it.

name: packsense-gold-build
purpose: Builds the finished tables that the pages of this site are drawn from.

name: packsense-health
purpose: Records how every job and outside service did, which is what this page shows.

name: packsense-publish
purpose: Sends the day's checked figures to this site.

name: packsense-reconcile-lookup
purpose: Asks Open Food Facts about products that seem to have gone, one by one, to see whether they were really removed.

name: packsense-archive
purpose: Copies the day's raw files to a second place, so there is a backup.

name: packsense-snapshots
purpose: Reads a full weekly copy of Open Food Facts to follow how its flags open and close over time.

name: packsense-reconcile-candidates
purpose: Makes the list of products that have vanished from Open Food Facts' daily files and may have been removed.

name: packsense-reconcile-load
purpose: Saves the results of those lookups, so every product gets a status.

name: packsense-egress-check
purpose: Checks that the outside services the jobs depend on can still be reached from where the jobs run.

name: packsense-release
purpose: Builds the monthly India data download.
